name: Woven Bubu Fish-Trap Display
description: Original Malaysian heritage display with a genuinely open woven bamboo-style body, a separately woven inward funnel with a clear throat, and two distinct exhibit cradles. Static and empty.
summary: Separate open tapered basket, inset woven funnel, and contemporary cradle.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original actual alternating rectangular ribbons for outer and inner lattices, independent annular binders and fitted stand, baked vertex colour, native Cycles preview.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Interpretive static exhibit; original proportions and pattern, no real fishing gear operation or standardized local form. Blender -Y front/+Z up, glTF +Z front/+Y up.
